calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as number_of_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL '2 hours') = '2025-12-01'

SELECT calendar_date, day_name, day_of_week
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  web_order_id,
  order_ts_utc,
  DATE(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL '2 hours') as order_date_helsinki,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_ts_utc) as utc_hour,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_ts_utc + INTERVAL '2 hours') as helsinki_hour
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc + INTERVAL '2 hours') = '2025-12-01'
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) as number_of_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = '2025-12-01'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'

SELECT status, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT MIN(order_ts_utc) as earliest_order_utc, MAX(order_ts_utc) as latest_order_utc,
       CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', MIN(order_ts_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) as earliest_helsinki,
       CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', MAX(order_ts_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS TIMESTAMP) as latest_helsinki
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = '2025-12-01'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
